name: Determining When a Student Fails a Course (Case 1)
description: Construct a program to determine whether a student fails the course based on the inputs that it receives from the instructor. The student fails the course if the exam score is less than 55 or student has more than 2 missing homework.

comments.content: We need to read and process the values that the instructor enters. To read the input values from the instructor, we need to define a Scanner object.

We can create a Scanner object using the operator new, as shown in this statement. The System.in object represents the standard input stream, which by default is the keyboard. It tells the java compiler that the input will be provided through keyboard.
We prompt the instructor to enter the exam score.
We need to read the exam score that the instructor enters and store it in a variable. We read the exam score by calling the nextInt() method because this input is an integer.
Note that if the instructor provides a non-integer number, an exception will be thrown because the input type is inconsistent with the expected data type, i.e., int.
We prompt the instructor to enter the number of missing homework.

We need to read the number of missing homework that the instructor enters and store it in a variable. We read the number of missing homework by calling the nextInt() method because this input is an integer.
Note that if the instructor provides a non-integer number, an exception will be thrown because the input type is inconsistent with the expected data type, i.e., int.
We close the scanner as we do not want to process any input from the instructor in the rest of the program.

We need two conditions to determine whether a student fails the course. We use the || operator (called or) to combine the two conditions. The first condition is to test if the exam score is less than 55 and the second condition is to test if the number of missing homework is more than 2.
Note that the || operator yields the result true if at least one of the conditions is true.
This statement prints true/false depending on whether the student fails the course. The printed value is followed by an end-of-line character in the end.
